proximity-voice-chat.Settings.DefaultPro: The amount of units the radius will be. Example: 100
The units with which the Default Proximity Radius is measured.
proximity-voice-chat.Settings.Debug.Hint: Logs every volume change, and why, to the browser console (F12).
proximity-voice-chat.Settings.FixPeerCon: Works around Foundry's built-in voice chat repeatedly replacing connections that take more than a few seconds to set up, which can leave people unable to hear each other. Everyone must reload after changing this.
proximity-voice-chat.UI.globalListen.On: Global Listening on: you hear everyone.
proximity-voice-chat.UI.globalListen.Off: Global Listening off: you hear players near your selected tokens, or near tokens you speak through if none are selected.
proximity-voice-chat.UI.globalSpeak.On: Global Speaking on: everyone hears you.
proximity-voice-chat.UI.globalSpeak.Off: Global Speaking off: players hear you only near the tokens you have selected, or tokens you've added yourself to with the token HUD.
proximity-voice-chat.UI.StaleScript: Proximity Voice Chat: this browser is running an old cached copy of the module script ({script}) but {installed} is installed. Clear this site's cached files (Ctrl+Shift+Delete, "Cached images and files") and reload.
proximity-voice-chat.Settings.HideCamera: Hide Foundry's camera dock for everyone. Voice keeps working; speaking cues and voice controls move to the tokens and the players list. Players can bring the dock back for themselves.
proximity-voice-chat.Settings.ShowCamera: Show Foundry's camera dock on this device even if the GM has hidden it, e.g. to see video.
proximity-voice-chat.Settings.SpeakingIn: How tokens show that the person speaking through them is talking. This is the table default; players can choose their own.
Your own choice of speaking cue, overriding the GM's default on this device.
proximity-voice-chat.Settings.OwnersSpea: Players speak through tokens of their assigned character, and of actors they've been given Owner permission on, without being added to the token's speaker list. Default "all players" ownership doesn't count.
